Surf Lesson Program

Catch Your First Wave Today

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-73cdeffb elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html:
The surf lessons program is a wave-filled journey, designed for both new and experienced surfers. It’s a doorway to learning how to surf, with safety and fun always in mind. This is a chance for every surfer to find their paradise, no matter the season. The program helps cultivate a growing love for surfing in a beautiful place. Catch your next wave with the help of experts who love the ocean.

Private lessons cost IDR 1,000,000 per person, for one or two people. Beginners learn on Middle Reef, where the waves are softer, a short walk down the beach from the resort. Board rental is IDR 150,000 a day if you want to practise between lessons.

children.html:
Mocean’s Surf Lesson makes the journey from novice to confident surfer exciting and easy.  Under the Indonesian sun, everyone learns the strong techniques and ocean insights needed to surf with confidence.

Mocean Beach Resort focuses on hands-on experience and personalized coaching. They help each surfer reach their full ability, overcoming fears with each wave. This supportive setting lets every surfer, no matter their skill level, feel a deep sense of accomplishment and a desire to keep exploring the ocean.

Surf Lessons for Every Level in Sumbawa

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-7cae5342 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: To truly embody the spirit of surfing, blending skill with style is essential. Our surf lessons are designed not just to teach the mechanics of surfing. children.html: Learning to surf at Mocean isn’t just about balancing on a board—it’s about discovering the rhythm of the ocean as if it were your own heartbeat. The sea becomes your classroom, the waves your teachers, and every tumble in the water a reminder that joy lives in surrender. With every push of the tide, you learn how to let go, rise again, and embrace the dance between body and ocean.

children.html:
Do I need any surf experience?

No. Lessons are designed for complete beginners as well as surfers who want to improve. Your coach starts with the essentials, like a strong pop-up and paddle technique, and builds from there.

Where do the surf lessons take place?

Beginners learn on Middle Reef, which has softer take-offs and mellow shoulders and sits a short walk down the beach from the resort.

How much does a surf lesson cost?

Private lessons are IDR 1,000,000 per person, for up to two people. Board rental is IDR 150,000 a day.
